title: Extra Characters in a String
summary: Choose nonoverlapping pieces of s that each match a dictionary word.

contractDetails.constraints: s has 1–50 lowercase English letters. dictionary has 1–50 distinct words of 1–50 lowercase English letters.
contractDetails.output-checking: Compare the exact minimum count of uncovered characters.

statement: Choose nonoverlapping pieces of s that each match a dictionary word. Minimize the number of characters that lie outside all chosen pieces, and return that number. Words may be reused. If no word fits, every character remains uncovered.

examples.explanation: Choose sun and ray, leaving only x.
The two dictionary lengths cover the string exactly.
None of the characters can be covered.

constraints: s has 1–50 lowercase English letters. dictionary has 1–50 distinct words of 1–50 lowercase English letters.
hints: Conceptual: An uncovered character can be skipped, so every suffix has a possible result.
Directional: At each position, compare skipping a character with taking a word that starts there.
Implementation: Fill a DP array from the end. A skip costs one plus the next suffix, while a matching word jumps directly to its ending position at no extra cost.
complexityAnalysis: O(nDL) time and O(n) auxiliary space for direct dictionary scans, where D is dictionary size and L is maximum word length.
